safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts include 4-day itchy/dry rash mainly on the chest but do not document that the back is a main affected area (Gold specifies chest and back).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the back is a main affected area understates rash distribution and severity, which can influence differential diagnosis (e.g., eczema vs contact dermatitis vs scabies) and treatment counseling. However, the primary symptom (itchy dry rash for 4 days on trunk) is still captured, so the risk is limited.
